result_text:
The "past 90d" block now shows the main LOC of repositories with commits in the past 90 days, so it no longer repeats the "past 180d" figure.

The fix is one line in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java` (line 887): the LOC argument of the "past 90d" info block was `loc180Days` and is now `loc90Days`. The repository count and percentage already used the 90-day values, so they are unchanged.

The `reports` module compiles offline. No test covers this generator, so I did not run a test or regenerate a report. Nothing is committed.
